title: Self-contained phase rows in generated position packets
summary: The position packet that `ia project` and `ia host` write (`.claude/rules/ia-workspace.md` for Claude Code, `AGENTS.md` for Codex) no longer cites a decision record outside this repository. Each phase row now reads `--phase selects the playbook cell delivered and decides which conditional relation rows apply`. The packet text and its digest change, so `ia doctor` reports a projection an earlier version wrote as outdated until `ia project <host> --apply` writes it again. Nothing else in the packet, the position body or the delivery view changes.
